t: In front of you, in Whitehall Gardens just south of Hungerford Bridge, stands the statue of Sir James Outram. It's a Grade II listed work by the sculptor Matthew Noble. Outram was a British army officer who served in the conquest of Sindh and in the Indian Rebellion of 1857. Noble was a leading Victorian portrait sculptor, who carved many monumental figures and busts of royalty and statesmen, some of which can be seen in Westminster Abbey, St Paul's Cathedral and Parliament Square.
